html:
G'oya

Ikkinchi eng katta summa bu eng katta summadan kichik summalar ichidagi eng kattasi. Ikkita MAX yetadi. Tashqi MAX yana bir ishni bajaradi: mos qator bo'lmasa ham agregat bitta qator qaytaradi, qiymati NULL.

Yechim

SELECT MAX(amount) AS second_amount
FROM payments
WHERE status = 'success'
  AND amount < (SELECT MAX(amount) FROM payments WHERE status = 'success')

Holat sharti ikki joyda turishi kerak. Namunadagi eng katta summa 900 000, lekin bu Bekzodning o'tmagan to'lovi. Ichki so'rovda shart bo'lmasa, 500 000 "ikkinchi" bo'lib chiqadi.

Tuzoqlar

Intervyuda eng ko'p yoziladigan javob ORDER BY ... LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1. Namunada 500 000 ikki marta bor, shuning uchun u ikkinchi o'rinni ham egallaydi:

Noto'g'riSELECT amount AS second_amount
FROM payments
WHERE status = 'success'
ORDER BY amount DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1

DISTINCT qo'shilsa takror muammosi yo'qoladi, lekin boshqasi qoladi: ikkinchi summa bo'lmasa so'rov bo'sh natija beradi, NULL emas. Uni skalyar subquery ichiga olsangiz, to'g'ri bo'ladi:

SELECT (
  SELECT DISTINCT amount FROM payments
  WHERE status = 'success'
  ORDER BY amount DESC
  LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
) AS second_amount

ROW_NUMBER ham takrorni ko'rmaydi. Oyna funksiyasi bilan yechmoqchi bo'lsangiz, DENSE_RANK() = 2 oling.
